items.raw_excerpt: One of Braga’s most distinctive historic buildings has reopened to the public after being closed for almost two years.
items.summary_en: A well-known old house in Braga has opened to the public again. The building was closed for almost two years. People can now walk through the old house and see it inside.

items.title_en: Historic House in Braga Opens Again After Two Years

items.raw_excerpt: CPI(M) leads a march to Srikakulam demanding a probe into Narayanapuram land grabbing, urging government action for farmers.
items.summary_en: Members of the CPI(M) party marched in Srikakulam in Andhra Pradesh. They asked the government to look into a land grabbing case at Narayanapuram. The party also asked for help for local farmers.
items.summary_ko: 안드라프라데시 스리카쿨람에서 공산당(마)당원이 시위를 벌였습니다. 당군은 나라야나푸라람 지역 땅 강탈 문제를 silêncio 수사와 Authorities에 요구했습니다. 아울러 지역 농민을 도와달라고_entropy 기다렸습니다.
items.title_en: Party Marches in Srikakulam Over Land Dispute

items.raw_excerpt: A woman living in Revoe, Blackpool, says she does not believe she will be able to afford a new home.
items.summary_en: A woman in Revoe, Blackpool, says she does not think she can afford a new home. She is worried the council will force her to sell her house.

items.raw_excerpt: El marmoleo, la firmeza de las fibras y la zona de origen de cada corte determinan su sabor, jugosidad y la mejor forma de prepararlo, ya sea a la parrilla, la plancha o el horno.
items.summary_en: Marbling, how firm the fibers are, and the part of the animal the meat comes from decide how it tastes and how juicy it is. The same cut can taste quite different depending on whether you grill it, pan-sear it, or bake it in the oven.
items.summary_ko: 고기의 맛과 육즙은 살코기가 섞인 정도, 결의 단단함, 몸의 어느 부위에서 왔는지에 따라 달라진다. 같은 부위라도 숯불에 구우냐, 프라이팬에 굽냐, 오븐에 구우냐에 따라 맛이 quite 달라진다.
items.title_en: What Is the Difference Between Marbled Steak, Plain Sirloin, and Fillet?

items.summary_en: A new ranking names Lisbon the happiest tourist destination on earth. The list comes from the Holiday Happiness Index by BookRetreats. Lisbon beat many well-known city breaks around the world.

items.raw_excerpt: New firefighters are putting out real fires for the first time on the job because there has been no live-fire training nationwide for a year.
items.summary_en: New firefighters in New Zealand are putting out real fires for the first time. The country stopped live fire training for a whole year. Now the drills have started again.

items.raw_excerpt: La ex de Álvaro Ballero se sinceró sobre su cercanía con el chico reality en "¿Volverías con tu ex? 2".
items.summary_en: Ludmila Ksenofontova, the ex-girlfriend of Alvaro Ballero, spoke on a reality TV show. She is sure that Kaoto only got close to her because she is famous. She says the attention came from her public exposure, not real feelings.

items.raw_excerpt: Auckland's villa-lined and leafy central suburbs are some of the city's most sought after and expensive, with the trendiest cafes and bars.
items.summary_en: Grey Lynn and Ponsonby started as working class areas of Auckland. Today they are leafy, full of villas, and among the most expensive suburbs in the city. They also have the trendiest cafes and bars.

items.raw_excerpt: In Portugal, a series of legislative changes have gradually removed the need to show on the windshields of standard private vehicles the old stickers relating to car insurance, vehicle inspections, and payment of the Single Circulation Tax (IUC).
items.summary_en: Portugal has changed its rules for private cars. Drivers no longer need to show insurance, inspection, or circulation tax stickers on the windshield.

items.title_en: Portugal drops old car window stickers

items.raw_excerpt: O candidato ao Governo do Paraná. senador Sergio Moro(PL-PR), votará no dia 4 de outubro, às 9 horas, no Clube Duque de Caxias, localizado na Rua Costa Rica, 1.173, no bairro Bacacheri, em Curitiba. A informação é de sua assessoria de imprensa. Na sequência, Moro acompanha a esposa, a candidata a deputada federal Rosangela Moro(PL), […]
items.summary_en: Senator Sergio Moro will vote on October 4 at 9 am at the Duque de Caxias club in Curitiba. He will go with his wife, Rosangela Moro, who is running for Congress. The club is on Rua Costa Rica in the Bacacheri neighborhood.
